svg.text: PolarOps (SIH26062) - System Architecture and Process Flowchart, plain-language edition

g.text: Goa decisions become new orders at the station
1 - AT THE STATION (works with NO internet)
PROCESS FLOWCHART - ONE BOX'S JOURNEY (follow 43 to 52)
Pack ship like a perfect suitcase
offline queue (Dexie outbox) - nothing is lost
each desk = one API route file
dashed boxes = connect after the hackathon, on purpose
HOW TO READ THIS PICTURE (for anyone, tech or not):
Numbers 1-57 = follow them in order, like a comic. Rectangle = someone or something DOES an action. Diamond = the system asks a yes/no question.
Oval = start or finish. Blue tint = works WITHOUT internet. Grey = outside world or "later". Pink dashed = friends we connect after the hackathon.
Thin solid line = information moving. Dashed line = happens automatically by itself. Tiny grey text under a box = the technical name (for engineers and judges).

svg.text: PolarOps SIH26062 - plain-language architecture + process flow - every numbered box is a real file or screen in the repository
